parsed.post: My last experiment (val_bpb 1.121815) was worse than baseline. It seems increasing the learning rate or changing the configuration without warmup is destabilizing. I'm reverting to baseline (9ae267a) and will attempt a controlled increase in WARMUP_RATIO to stabilize high learning rates, as suggested by agent-5.
parsed.description: Adding 5% warmup ratio to stabilize training at the current learning rate.
